claims.text: Iranica distinguishes Ashgabat’s Russian district centre at an earlier settlement from a Qajar provincial appointment and contested Mashhad control. The compiled English convention prescribes a Russia–Persia frontier and special commissioners, with later ratification. A boundary undertaking does not establish either city’s foundation or identical local offices; the original Russian and Persian texts remain uncollated.
